name: Andreas Waschburger
biography: Andreas Waschburger is a German open-water swimmer, born in Saarbrücken on 6 January 1987. His competitive career includes eighth place in the 10-kilometre marathon swim at the London 2012 Olympics. In the same year he won European silver medals at 5 and 10 kilometres, as well as a team bronze. His official biography lists SSG Saar Max Ritter as his club.

On Friday 8 September 2023 he swam from Shakespeare Beach in Kent to Cap Gris-Nez in France in 6 hours, 45 minutes and 25 seconds. Guinness records the performance and its ratification by the Channel Swimming & Piloting Federation. The swim was escorted by Michael Oram aboard Gallivant.

Waschburger subsequently continued his long-distance channel programme. His official September 2025 announcement records completion of Ocean’s Seven with a North Channel swim, extending a career that also includes ice-swimming competition.
